2026-11-18: the Po web standard

  • Shared po-tokens.css first; the app tokens at the top of modern-ui.css alias to --po-* (indigo accent, device light/dark, Inter + Space Grotesk; Material Symbols subset kept).
  • Header: full-width .po-header, name upper-left, a plain-link settings gear upper-right (works under static SSR). The developer persona dropdown and the bottom-nav Settings slot are gone.
  • One .po-version stamp: UTC date of HEAD from Directory.Build.props.
  • /diag: estate cards and badges. Tab with nothing focused opens /po-dev.html.
  • Fish Audio chip no longer overlaps its service name.
